description.fun: Dedenne's branched whiskers are antennae: it chats with other Dedenne over long distances, sharing where to find food and electricity. Its own power organ is too small to make much charge, so it tops up from other Electric Pokémon or by plugging its tail into a wall socket, which is why it lives near people. Japanese fans voted it Pokémon of the Year in 2021.
description.guide: Dedenne is an Electric- and Fairy-type Pokémon from Kalos, a mouse with antenna-like whiskers. It can't generate much electricity on its own, so it absorbs it from other Pokémon or from power outlets. It uses its whiskers to communicate with others of its kind over long distances.
description.tagline: A tiny antenna mouse that charges itself from wall sockets
